finding.defect: Requested K was the size of a factor pool sampled with replacement, not the realised number of occupied confound blocks.
finding.consequence: At K=N_EDGES=200, the world is not guaranteed one factor per edge. Therefore the committed curve cannot support the claimed degenerate endpoint 'edge-specific hidden factor' or the conclusion that the observed K=200 point is structurally identical to BIOLOGY_POSITIVE.
finding.expected_occupied_at_K200: approximately 126.6 under the historical sampling-with-replacement construction
finding.runner_gap: The historical runner checked only confound_blocks_K == requested K and reported nominal edges_per_block=N_EDGES/K; it did not verify realised occupancy or block sizes.

historical_curve_numbers.note: These values remain valid measurements of the historical generator. They must be described as a curve over requested factor-pool size under sampling-with-replacement, not as an exact K-block partition experiment.

s102_boundary.statement: Even a repaired K-partition curve characterizes the historical executor G2 implementation unless and until G2 semantics are prospectively specified. No post-hoc G2 threshold or equivalence margin is introduced here.

requirements: exactly K occupied factors for every requested K
balanced block sizes differing by at most one
K=N_EDGES requires every block size exactly 1
world manifest records realised occupancy, block-size range, full block-size vector and digest
runner fails closed if realised occupancy or singleton endpoint checks fail
re-run uses a new V2_PARTITION_REPAIRED receipt rather than overwriting historical V1 curve
